page.layout: Full-width title block at top: "(I)" page number, then "INTRODUCTIO" (cut off at the right edge), then "Ad Lectionem Linguae Hebraicae & Chaldaicae." Bottom: signature "D" at the foot.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the end of the title "INTRODUCTIO" and the right-hand part of the Potestas column; the cut-off words are not transcribed. The Hebrew vowel points are copied as far as they could be read. The Ajin row is only partly visible: its Hebrew and power are not legible. A dash after "L." in the Lamed row is a printed mark and is left out. The figure column shows final forms for Caph, Mem and Nun, which are copied as printed.
